record.question: Which colour typically represents blood flow moving away from the transducer in a standard colour map?
record.explanation: Answer D: Blue. In the conventional red/blue Doppler map, blue indicates flow away from the transducer; maps can be inverted by operator settings. Source/context note: The red/blue map convention is configurable and can be inverted. Reference: https://www.radiologyinfo.org/en/info/voidcysto; https://www.radiologyinfo.org/en/info/bodyct. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
